title_en: The First Day at the Café
description_ru: Новая сотрудница учится готовить кофе, ошибается и узнаёт главный секрет хорошей работы.
text:
Mr. Carlos: Good morning, Nina. Welcome to the Blue Cup Café. Please come in.
Nina: Good morning, Mr. Carlos. Thank you for the job. I am very happy to be here.
Mr. Carlos: We open at seven, so you have thirty minutes to learn. First, here is your apron. It is blue, like our cups.
Nina: It is nice. Thank you. What do I do first?
Mr. Carlos: First, wash your hands. Then, put the clean cups on the shelf. Always put the handles on the right.
Nina: The handles on the right. Okay, I understand.

Mr. Carlos: Now this is the coffee machine. It is old, but it is my best friend. Be careful. The steam is very hot.
Nina: How do I make a cappuccino?
Mr. Carlos: Watch me. First, you put the coffee in here. Then you press this button and wait. While you wait, you heat the milk with this little pipe.
Nina: That is a lot of steps. I think I forget something.
Mr. Carlos: Everybody forgets in the first week. Don't worry. Here, you try now. Make one for yourself.
Nina: Oh no! There is too much milk. It goes everywhere!

Mr. Carlos: Ha ha! That is okay. Take a cloth and clean the table. Then try again. Slowly this time.
Nina: Now the milk looks better. Is this correct?
Mr. Carlos: Yes, very good! Taste it. What do you think?
Nina: It is a little bitter, but it is warm and nice. I want to learn more.
Mr. Carlos: Good. It is seven o'clock. I open the door now. Our first customer is always Mr. Pine. He wants a black coffee and a small cake.
Nina: Black coffee and a small cake. I can do that.

Nina: Good morning, sir. What would you like today?
Mr. Pine: A black coffee, please, and a piece of apple cake. Are you new here?
Nina: Yes, it is my first day. I am a little nervous.
Mr. Pine: Don't be nervous. This is the best café in the city. Everybody is friendly, and Carlos is a good man.
Nina: Thank you. Here is your coffee. Be careful, it is hot.
Mr. Pine: It looks perfect. See you tomorrow, young lady.

Nina: Mr. Carlos, it is eleven o'clock, and the café is full. There are twenty people and only two of us. I am running everywhere!
Mr. Carlos: This is our busy time. Take the orders from the window table. I make the drinks.
Nina: Two teas, one orange juice and three chocolate cakes. Anything else?
Mr. Carlos: Yes, the big group at the back wants sandwiches. Ask them what they want.
Nina: Excuse me, what would you like to eat? We have cheese, ham and tomato sandwiches.
Customer: Five cheese sandwiches and a big bottle of water, please.

Mr. Carlos: Nina, one thing about our customers. Always look at their faces and say hello with a smile.
Nina: Even when they are angry?
Mr. Carlos: Yes, especially then. A smile is free, and it fixes many problems.
Nina: I try. My face is a little tired, but I try.
Mr. Carlos: Good. Now it is lunchtime. Eat a sandwich in the kitchen, and rest for ten minutes.
Nina: Thank you. I am so hungry. May I have the cheese one?

Nina: Mr. Carlos, I make a mistake. I give the ham sandwich to a woman and she is a vegetarian!
Mr. Carlos: Don't panic. Take it back and say sorry. Then make a new one with cheese.
Nina: I am so sorry, madam. I bring you a new sandwich right now. It is free.
Customer: Thank you. That is very kind. Mistakes happen. You are doing well.
Nina: Thank you, madam. I feel terrible, but I am learning.
Mr. Carlos: You see? You say sorry, you smile, and the customer is happy. That is the secret of this job.

Mr. Carlos: It is five o'clock. We close now. How do you feel after your first day?
Nina: I am very tired, and my feet hurt a lot, like after a long walk in the mountains. But I feel good. I like the work and I like the people.
Mr. Carlos: You are a fast learner. Tomorrow you can make the coffee for Mr. Pine yourself.
Nina: Really? Without your help?
Mr. Carlos: Yes. And one more thing. Here is a small present for your first day.
Nina: A blue cup with my name on it! Oh, Mr. Carlos, thank you so much. I love it.
Mr. Carlos: Every worker here has one. Put it on the shelf with the handle on the right. See you tomorrow at seven.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Звуки p, t, k в начале слога произносите с лёгким придыханием, как маленький выдох.
Кончик языка слегка между зубами, воздух выдыхайте мягко; не заменяйте на «с» или «з».
Задняя часть языка опущена, кончик языка касается дёсен; не смягчайте «l» как русское «ль».
Короткий звук между «и» и «ы»; не растягивайте его как «ии».

questions.question: What is the name of the café?
What does Nina do wrong with the first cappuccino?
questions.answer: She puts in too much milk.

questions.question: What does Mr. Pine order?
questions.answer: A black coffee and a piece of apple cake.

questions.question: What present does Nina get?
questions.answer: A blue cup with her name on it.
